name: Hydrafacial Keravive

lead: Keravive is a clinic scalp treatment that cleanses, exfoliates and applies serums to the scalp. It is marketed for scalp health and hair quality, including for thinning hair.
Two small studies are registered, one completed in androgenetic alopecia, but no results were found.

paras: A handheld device performs cleansing and exfoliation and delivers topical products to the scalp, in the manner of the brand's facial treatment.
No safety data were found in the sources reviewed. Whether it affects hair growth has not been shown by published trials.

trials.title: Scalp Serum Paired With HydraFacial HydraScalp Keravive™ Treatment in Patients With Self-Perceived Hair Thinning
Keravive by Hydrafacial for Scalp Health and Enhanced Hair Quality

lead: Hydrafacial Keravive (also marketed as HydraScalp) is a scalp treatment from the HydraFacial brand that adapts the company's multi-step facial platform for the scalp, aimed at cleansing, exfoliation and the delivery of topical serums to improve scalp health and hair appearance.

Evidence is limited to registered studies. A 44-person study of the treatment in androgenetic alopecia is listed as completed, and a 15-person study pairing a scalp serum with the treatment in people with self-perceived hair thinning is registered but not yet recruiting.[1][2] No published results were found.

paras: The treatment applies the HydraFacial approach of cleansing, exfoliating and infusing products to the scalp. Providers promote it for scalp health and hair quality; this is the marketing position rather than an established clinical outcome.

NCT06112782, "Keravive by Hydrafacial for Scalp Health and Enhanced Hair Quality," enrolled 44 participants with androgenetic alopecia, began in 2019 and is listed as completed.[2] NCT07935993 is planned to begin in November 2026 with 15 participants with self-perceived hair thinning, testing a scalp serum together with the treatment.[1] No results from either were found in the sources reviewed.

timeline.event: A study of Keravive for scalp health and hair quality in androgenetic alopecia starts.[2]
A trial pairing a scalp serum with the treatment is registered for patients with hair thinning.[1]
